features.name: FastAPI control app
features.detail: QI module contract (Law 2): GET /health -> {status:ok}, /version -> {claude_voice, 0.1.0, active_development}, /info reads qi_registry.json and returns this project's entry. Loopback-only on 127.0.0.1:8720, never tunneled.

features.name: Config + bridge-health endpoints
features.detail: GET /config returns config.json (graceful-degrade envelope, Law 3); GET /bridge/health serves data/bridge_health.json written by the hourly probe.

features.name: Brain control + toggle UI
features.detail: GET /brain (active/default/locked/registry), POST /brain/active, POST /brain/config (locked/default/address_toggle, pins active->default when locking). GET / serves BRAIN_HTML — a segmented Claude/Ronald toggle with a hard-set lock, polling /brain every 3s.

features.name: Quick TTS smoke test
features.detail: POST /say {text, lang} speaks a line in Claude's male voice via edge_tts + realtime.play_interruptible.

features.name: Free real-Claude via headless CLI
features.detail: Spawns `claude -p --output-format text --no-session-persistence --model sonnet` via subprocess, prompt over STDIN, neutral cwd (tempdir) so no project CLAUDE.md auto-loads. Uses CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (subscription) — deliberately NOT --bare (which would force the metered API key). One-shot yield; ~20s/turn.

features.name: Ollama / Anthropic / OpenRouter adapters
features.detail: stream_ollama POSTs /api/chat (local, default, llama3.1:8b). stream_anthropic uses the messages.stream API (disabled). stream_openrouter via OpenAI-compatible client; key from env or shared C:\QI\maia.db. Each is independently enable/disable + toggleable in config.

features.name: Fallback router
features.detail: enabled_chain orders active-first then config 'order' among enabled providers. stream_reply yields ('__provider__', name) then (name, chunk); on any provider exception it logs and tries the next (Law 3 — degrade, never crash). Raises only if every enabled backend fails.

features.name: Secret + key loading
features.detail: _load_env parses secrets/claude_voice.env into os.environ (no dependency). _openrouter_key falls back to keys stored in C:\QI\maia.db (config/settings tables) like Gamez.

features.name: Named-brain registry + merge
features.detail: Two brains: 'claude' (engine claude_cli, voice Andrew) and 'ronald' (engine ollama, voice Brian, anti-hallucination system prompt). brains_cfg shallow-merges config top level and deep-merges registry entries over the defaults.

features.name: Persisted active state + lock
features.detail: Active brain persists in data/brain_state.json (shared by chat toggles and the :8720 UI). effective_active returns the configured default when locked (a true hard-set), else the last-toggled active.

features.name: Address matching (mishearing-tolerant)
features.detail: Matches a leading brain name with homophone address_terms (cloud/claud/clawed...) + an edit-distance-1 fuzzy fallback + a single leading filler word ('hey claude'). stt_hint() biases Whisper toward the brain names.

features.name: Turn resolution + take-a-break
features.detail: Returns target/engine/voice/system_prompt/route/control_reply/clean_text/switched_to. '<name>, take a break' hands to the other brain; a bare name wakes+greets (no LLM); a real message routes to the addressed brain.

features.name: Synchronous converse + bridge round-trip
features.detail: converse() runs one full voice turn, mutating history. Legacy bridge engine drops into claude_bridge/inbox.jsonl and polls outbox.jsonl up to timeout; honest fallback to the other brain only if fallback_to_local. run_local forces the resolved engine via _cfg_for_engine.

features.name: Whisper STT (local, CPU int8)
features.detail: faster-whisper on device=cpu, compute_type=int8 (CUDA libs absent in this Windows Python). Uses brain.stt_hint() initial_prompt; respects stt.language (English-forced).

features.name: Energy VAD / PTT capture
features.detail: capture_vad: sounddevice InputStream, RMS energy gate (start_rms 0.015), trailing-silence end (silence_ms 700), min_speech + max_utterance guards. capture_ptt: Enter to start/stop. Mode = vad | wake | ptt from config.listening.

features.name: Per-sentence streaming TTS + barge-in
features.detail: Buffers the reply, flushes complete sentences (_SENT_END) to edge-tts and plays via ffplay as they arrive. play_interruptible watches mic RMS during playback and terminates ffplay on sustained speech (barge-in disabled by default to avoid self-trigger without headphones).

features.name: Main loop + dual-brain greet
features.detail: IDLE->LISTENING->THINKING->SPEAKING loop; greets as the active brain, routes each utterance via brain.converse() (40s bridge timeout). Speaks any honest hand-off note. Works but ~20s/turn on the free CLI path; LiveKit rebuild is the planned fix.

features.name: Signed webhook + async offload
features.detail: POST /line/webhook verifies X-Line-Signature via WebhookParser, returns 200 fast and offloads each event to a worker thread (run_in_executor). linebot.v3 messaging SDK; reply + push paths.

features.name: Owner vs guest routing
features.detail: Owner identified by LINE userId -> full assistant + dual-brain routing + binding /commands (/stop /resume /guests /directive /cleardirective /reset /video /whoami). Everyone else -> GUEST_PROMPT social-only face. Global pause + guest gating honoured.

features.name: Voice in / voice out
features.detail: Inbound audio -> ffmpeg 16k mono -> faster-whisper (with stt_hint). Outbound replies -> edge-tts (pronunciation-fixed) -> ffmpeg AAC .m4a served from /audio/{fname}; AudioMessage attached when public_base_url set.

features.name: Bridge-push delivery path
features.detail: Legacy BRAIN_MODE=bridge watches the bus outbox and PUSHes the real Claude's reply (reply token expired). Superseded by the claude_cli backend but retained for back-compat.

features.name: Long-poll bot loop
features.detail: Outbound getUpdates long-poll (no inbound port, no tunnel). Commands /start /reset /whoami /voice /video. allowed_chat_ids locks the bot to specific chats; per-chat history + voice-on override.

features.name: Dual-brain reply + delivery
features.detail: Routes through brain.resolve(); control commands answered directly; bridge engine submits to the bus; local engine runs brain.run_local. _deliver sends text + (modality-gated) OGG/Opus voice note.

features.name: Voice note transcode
features.detail: Inbound .oga -> ffmpeg 16k mono wav -> Whisper. Outbound edge-tts mp3 -> ffmpeg libopus 48k mono OGG voice note (Telegram-native).

features.name: WebSocket room + roster
features.detail: ws://:8722/ws?name=&kind= joins humans/agents; each participant gets a distinct VOICE_POOL voice; shared transcript broadcast to all; Claude greets each joiner; transcript clears when the room empties.

features.name: Active-brain host
features.detail: Host follows the global active brain (shared via brain_state.json). build_messages injects a grounded system prompt (only real participants, no fake screen/file/vision features). claude_cli/ollama run synchronously; legacy bridge path falls back honestly.

features.name: Turn-taking + interjection
features.detail: Host replies when addressed by name or to an open human message; stays silent when a human addresses another participant; may interject only on a strong, respectful disagreement (else replies EXACTLY [pass]).

features.name: STT endpoint + minutes export
features.detail: POST /stt transcribes browser mic audio (Whisper). POST /minutes synthesises structured markdown minutes and renders a .docx (python-docx) to data/minutes, downloadable at /minutes/file/{name}.

features.name: Junction-box TTS
features.detail: Every participant's text is synthesised in their own voice (edge-tts, pronunciation-fixed) and served from /media; humans' speech is transcribed — text<->voice<->text for the whole room.

features.name: Agent participant template
features.detail: Demo agent joins over WebSocket as kind=agent, answers only when addressed by name (stops bot-to-bot loops), thinks with a local Ollama persona, never invents participants/features.

features.name: Always-on service installer
features.detail: Self-elevating NSSM installer (nssm at C:\QIH\engine\bin) for QI_ClaudeVoiceTunnel, QI_ClaudeVoiceLine (:8721), QI_ClaudeVoiceTelegram, QI_ClaudeVoiceControl (:8720). Sets AppDirectory + Description per QI service rule; SERVICE_AUTO_START.

features.name: Meeting-room daily task
features.detail: QI_ClaudeVoiceMeeting_8AM runs the room at 08:00 via conhost --headless cmd /c (a .bat, not pythonw -> avoids the stdout-null crash). RunLevel Limited (no admin), Interactive, StartWhenAvailable, Hidden.

features.name: Bridge health monitor
features.detail: Hourly QI_ClaudeVoiceBridgeCheck: verifies token present + kind (subscription-oauth vs api-key), claude CLI resolvable, brain wired to claude_cli, a LIVE probe ('BRIDGE OK') with latency, and the three /health endpoints. Writes data/bridge_health.json; alerts via Tasuke + BRIDGE_PENDING_REVIEW.json on failure.

features.name: ffmpeg resolver (service-safe)
features.detail: Resolves ffmpeg/ffprobe via config dir -> PATH -> common install dirs -> WinGet packages glob, fixing the empty-PATH service account that silently dropped voice notes.

features.name: Spoken-only pronunciation + modality
features.detail: pronounce.apply rewrites speech only ('the owner'->'Renee', whole-word, case-preserving). modality.choose picks text/voice/video per turn from length + moment detection; cooldown-gated video.
